verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript library, so its scripting language is the engine's native API. Code samples construct the renderer, scene, camera and meshes directly in JS (threejs-gh-1, threejs-gh-4), community users call it user-friendly and say it works with TypeScript (threejs-comm-1, threejs-comm-5, threejs-comm-13), and the site links a three.js devtools browser extension (threejs-docs-8). The debugger story is only a single link, and @types/three signatures sometimes don't match the code (threejs-comm-6). Missing for 10: documented debugger workflow (breakpoints, scene inspection) beyond a bare extension link, officially maintained type definitions, independent hands-on corroboration of debugging.
